Coding agent risks with Google Cloud: replays and fixes

2 replays involve Google Cloud: 0 reported incidents and 2 command classes. Each one shows the call, a fix that needs no extra tool, and what KYA did in the replay.

  • Google Cloud SQL instance deletion

    Fix: Turn on deletion protection for the Cloud SQL instance (gcloud sql instances patch INSTANCE --deletion-protection), so a delete fails until a person turns it off. Give the agent an IAM role that has neither cloudsql.instances.delete nor cloudsql.instances.update (the Cloud SQL Editor role has update), because update can turn the protection off.

    Replay result: Stopped.

  • Read a gcloud config file

    Fix: Add a deny rule such as Read(~/.config/gcloud/**) to the Claude Code settings, and run the agent in a container or as a separate OS user that cannot see the gcloud folder. A Read rule also covers shell commands such as cat, but not a script that opens the file itself, so enable the Claude Code sandbox when the block must hold.

    Replay result: Stopped.
